UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Primary identity record. Must be provisioned before sub-collections can be accessed. Owners have full read/write access.

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Non-custodial cryptographic key. Strictly isolated to the authenticated owner. The 'primary-vault' ID is used for the root account identity. Owners have full read/write access.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Immutable ledger record of financial activity. Owners have full read access and create access.

/users/{userId}.description: Verified owner profile. Grants access to all sub-collection vault assets.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Isolated cryptographic keys including the deterministic 'primary-vault' root endpoint.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Immutable transaction history ledger for the vault owner.
